The plate is square and about 20-22 cm across. It holds roughly 3 strips of cooked bacon, which look like about 2-3 slices. Cooked bacon weighs about 8 g per slice, so 3 slices come to roughly 24 g. At about 5.4 kcal/g for cooked bacon, that is around 130 kcal. Because the pieces are folded and overlapping, the total may be a little higher, so I estimate about 25 g and 135 kcal.
